entries.officialDescription: With the strength and agility of a Lycan, a clumsy flail in an attempt to hit something becomes a nearly inescapable barrage. entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: With your new legs you send a mighty leaping kick to the head of your enemy, causing them, at the very least, to become really dizzy, reducing critical strike chance by 50% and Dodge Chance by 30% for 20 seconds. If the opponent was stunned by Howl of Terror, increases their incoming damage by either 15%, 20%, 25%, or 30% proportional to the length of the stun.
notes: Deals 350% damage to a target in melee range.
Applies Disoriented to the enemy, lowering their critical strike chance by 50% and their dodge chance by 30%. Lasts 15 seconds.
